# Data Source: catalyst_filestore_folders

Deprecated: Zoho has announced File Store sunset on 31 October 2026; use Stratus for new storage. See the [vendor announcement](https://docs.catalyst.zoho.com/en/announcements/2026/filestore-sunset/). List existing File Store folders. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.folders.READ`. It does not download files or create folders. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

~> **Note:** File Store discovery is deprecated. Use Stratus for new storage;
migration of existing files and permissions is separate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_filestore_folders" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "folders" {
  value = data.catalyst_filestore_folders.example.folders
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `folders` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
